Here’s a design layout suggestion, and I’ll write it out like it would be in a poster style (you can use this for making it in Canva, PowerPoint, or design tools): --- **[Title Block: Centered at the Top]** **Rubrics for CA3** *Understand the Criteria to Excel!* --- **[Main Block: Two Big Sections Side by Side]** | **Thinking Ability** *(Map shows complex thinking about meaningful relationships)* **(6 marks)** | **Creativity & Representation** *(Information is presented clearly and shows a meaningful relationship)* **(4 marks)** | |--------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------| | **Excellent (6)**
Ideas provide a complete picture with a high degree of imagination and creativity, and submitted on time. | **Excellent (4)**
Conceptual accuracy, visual clarity, creativity, and submission on time. | | **Good (4)**
Some ideas radiate out from the center with creativity, but submitted not on time. | **Good (2)**
Partial conceptual accuracy and visual clarity, creativity, and submitted not on time. | | **Needs Improvement (2)**
Not very clear in concepts. | **Needs Improvement (1)**
Not very clear in concepts. | --- **[Footer Block: Centered]** **!!! Best of Luck !!!** --- ### Notes for design: - Use bold headings for sections. - Use colored blocks for each level (Green for Excellent, Yellow for Good, Red for Needs Improvement). - Keep a light background with sharp borders between blocks for easy reading. - Add icons next to "Creativity", "Accuracy", and "Timeliness" to make it visually catchy. - Optionally, place the scoring out of 10 at the bottom corner: **Total: /10** --- If you want, I can also make an actual graphic version for you!
